title: Relationship
description: A directed outbound edge from the artifact version that carries it to another artifact version. Legal rel_type values and target kinds are declared per kind in the kind manifest's x-registry-edges. Inbound edges are never stored. File spec sections 3.4, 4.3 and 6.

rel_type.description: Edge type, for example depends_on or supersedes.

to.description: Target as a fully qualified ref, resolved within the same root.

range.description: Only on a depends_on edge whose target version parses as semver: the versions of the target this version works with, as space-separated comparators that must all hold. to names the version the publisher tested with and MUST satisfy the range. A client that does not resolve ranges installs to exactly. File spec section 3.4.
